cases.explain: «небесные чертоги» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,

cases.explain: «полевых зверей» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.

cases.explain: «небесные птицы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

cases.explain: «небесных чертогов» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Like a father has compassion on his children, so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him.

cases.explain: «Высокие горы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.

cases.explain: «диких козлов» — after the preposition «для», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.

cases.explain: «Молодые львы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Praise Yahweh, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.
